items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I told you - I worked with Art Hodes.

ctx.x: Somebody stabbed the checkroom girl and some fag got killed in there and they closed it up. So, now you know it's not easy to get a place open like that, to beat all those things and they're very

particular about what goes in there after a thing like that happens. So, they kept postponing his opening and Art Hodes and, so, I saw Art Hodes was working in a club in the Village and, uh, I can't just name the club but it was Art Hodes, and Moore on the drums - Freddie Moore---

items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I went in there with Max Kaminsky and Freddy , and then I came back or either extended the engagement when Max had left with Wild Bill Davison and Freddy , working off as the group

ctx.x: He worked also as an act, and that's where Big Bill -- I always remember, Big Bill Broonzy and Wild Bill Davison and going out and getting a fifth of booze, of some kind of whiskey. And Wild Bill had a drink and then Big Bill grabbed the bottle. And when he got through putting it down behind -- from his mouth, I could see where the bottom of his fist was, the whiskey was below that bottom. And I says, no more, I ain't going in with him in no bottles no more.

But he was a real warm character, and he was a great player.
